title: S4-DRAW-02 — The curve can be reconsidered.
goal: The Bezier Curve tool offers its stroke presets and curve tightness; a click without a drag commits nothing, so the artwork and history stay exactly as they were (a curve is only committed from its draft).

steps.why: A click is not a curve: nothing is committed without a draft.

cliOnly: dragging a curve draft, adjusting its bend and end handles, Cancel, Apply, Re-edit with its original colour and refusal of stale ownership (tests/production/curveOwnership.spec.ts, tests/production/curveColorRetention.spec.ts)
